technical.summary: RTX shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (RSI-9, Stoch-K), weak trend strength (ADX 14.34), and declining volume undermine conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: RTX shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract visibility, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 12 days present elevated volatility risk with no offsetting smart money accumulation.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is neutral with only small-value mixed trades and no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (399.84), flat yield curve, recent CPI miss, and earnings in 12 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for RTX.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with Hull flip, three white soldiers, and supertrend bullish signals in extreme fear regime (VIX crisis) creates contrarian buy opportunity near support at 93.838.
debate.key_bear_argument: RSI-9 overbought with falling momentum, weak ADX trend confirmation (14.34), negative CMF distribution, declining volume, high earnings risk in 12 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction in unfavorable macro environment (VIX 399.84, flat yield curve) make this a low-probability swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive with price above all major MAs and bullish candlestick patterns, but overbought oscillators (RSI-9, Stoch-K 83.6) combined with weak trend confirmation (ADX 14.34) and declining volume signal deteriorating entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 12 days with zero fundamental conviction, extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve), and negative CMF distribution suggest high probability of mean reversion into earnings.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on low conviction; bear case dominates across technical (overbought/weak trend), fundamental (no conviction), and macro (crisis regime) dimensions
